identity_sources.notes: Q664547 identifies the cantonal Grand Council. Entity revision 2555716667 gives official website http://www.gr.be.ch/; current HTTPS official site confirms the institution and crosslinks Online-Tagblatt. Not the municipality, executive or parliament building.

channel.provenance_note: Official archive of the legislature of the Swiss canton of Bern. The parliamentary site links Online-Tagblatt for recorded proceedings, votes and transcripts. A dated autumn-session recording passed video decode and advancing-playback checks; this does not validate a current live stream or committee-room coverage.

accessibility.notes: A transcript is visible beside the sampled 31 August 2026 recording. No text tracks were exposed by that video element; caption, sign-language and audio-description coverage across the service remains unverified.

permission.summary: The cantonal notice generally restricts off-site use of audiovisual elements, which may belong to third parties; case-by-case permission may be requested. No independent media-reuse permission is established.
permission.recommendation: Open the official archive for viewing and transcripts. Keep this source link-out only; obtain applicable permission before independent playback, embedding, extraction or redistribution.
